verdict.rationale: Link CLI explicitly gives agents access to a customer-controlled wallet, retrieving one-time-use payment credentials for spend and reading balances/transactions from connected accounts, with every spend gated by human approval in the Link app — directly matching funded/controlled wallet + balance visibility. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond Stripe's own docs and GitHub repo description, and clarity on whether the 'wallet' is a dedicated funded store vs. linked bank/card instruments.
